pages.text: A gun barrel starts as a bar of steel.
pages.title: Barrels

pages.text: On a Create line a steel ingot is flooded with 50 mB of lubrication oil, drilled through on a saw, reamed on a second saw and straightened on a press, the barrel blank turning into a gun barrel: a gun drill runs in oil pumped down its own shank, then reaming and rifling, and straightening by eye on a press, as barrel makers still do.
A ground lens is glass polished with sand paper, garnet paper or emery cloth.

The weapon printer machines the rest. A pistol is a barrel, a gun mechanism, HSLA steel for the slide and plastic for the frame; an AR-15 or a SCAR has an aluminium receiver; an AK, a G3 or a shotgun is steel throughout, with wood where it has wood. Gun mechanisms are two hardened steel springs, a steel mechanism and screws.
pages.title: The printer

pages.text: Machine guns take a spare barrel and two steel mechanisms for the feed, and the minigun six barrels and an electric motor. Red dots and holographic sights take an LED chip and a cell; launchers take aluminium tubes, and the Javelin's seeker germanium optics.

Point Blank's gunmetal, copper and iron smelted together, is gone, and so is its minigun motor: the M134 has always been driven by an electric motor, and here The Factory's turns it. Arms dealers in villages still sell guns for emeralds; that is the pack's setting, not this mod's.
